title: Smooth accordion
sub: Answers grow open, the others close
html:
Yes. Cancel from Billing in two clicks, no fees and no questions.

Every plan starts with 14 free days. No card needed to begin.

Full refund within 30 days of purchase, paid back to your card.

Upgrade or downgrade whenever you like. We prorate the difference.
prompt: Build a smooth FAQ accordion where opening one answer closes the others. Style it as a flat list inside one rounded white card: each row has a mono index number ("01"), the question in semibold 13px and a 1px hairline between rows; the number turns your accent color when its row is open. Animate the panel with the grid trick instead of height: put the answer in a wrapper with display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr, give its only child overflow: hidden and min-height: 0, and on open switch the wrapper to grid-template-rows: 1fr with transition: grid-template-rows 520ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Fade and lift the answer text at the same time (opacity 0 to 1, translateY(-4px) to 0, delayed 90ms) so it feels like it settles into place. Opening a row removes .open from its siblings so exactly one is open, and clicking the open row closes it. Animate only grid-template-rows, opacity and transform. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Plus to minus
html:

prompt: Build an FAQ where the plus icon morphs into a minus. Each question sits on its own white rounded card with the icon at the right: a 22px circle holding two 10px x 2px bars, one horizontal and one rotated 90deg. When the item opens, rotate the vertical bar back to 0deg while scaling it to scaleX(.2) and fading it to opacity 0, so it rotates away and only the horizontal bar remains, and flip the circle to your accent with white bars. Use a slight-overshoot spring such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%) over 600ms for the bar. Animate the panel with the grid trick instead of height: put the answer in a wrapper with display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr, give its only child overflow: hidden and min-height: 0, and on open switch the wrapper to grid-template-rows: 1fr with transition: grid-template-rows 520ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Hover scales the idle icon to 1.1. Mark the icon aria-hidden; the button's aria-expanded carries the state. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Single open
sub: One item at a time, soft blue fill
html:
Visa, Mastercard, Amex and bank transfer on yearly plans.

Nonprofits and students get 40 percent off. Just ask support.

Most replies land within two hours, every day of the week.

Export everything as CSV or JSON at any time from Settings.
prompt: Build a single-open FAQ: exactly one answer is visible at any time and opening another closes the current one. Give each row a leading radio-style dot (14px ring that fills with a 4.5px accent border when selected) so the single-select behavior reads at a glance. The open row gets a soft fill from your accent tint, a 1px accent-line inset ring (box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px, not a left border) and an accent-ink question color, all crossfading over 380ms with cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Idle rows are white with a 1px hairline. Animate the panel with the grid trick instead of height: put the answer in a wrapper with display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr, give its only child overflow: hidden and min-height: 0, and on open switch the wrapper to grid-template-rows: 1fr with transition: grid-template-rows 520ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Clicking the open row keeps it open, which is the single-open convention; keep a data-open attribute on the list so the open index is easy to restore after navigation. Animate grid-template-rows, background and box-shadow only. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. prompt: Build a live-filter FAQ search. A 36px rounded search field (search icon, text input, small mono result count at the right) sits above a list of questions in one white card. On every input event, lowercase the query, test each question with indexOf, and for matches wrap the matched slice in a <mark> with an accent-soft background, accent-ink text and a 2px soft box-shadow halo; non-matches collapse out. Collapse rows without animating height: each row is display: grid with grid-template-rows: 1fr that transitions to 0fr (with opacity 0) over 420ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), and its child has overflow: hidden and min-height: 0. Update the count ("2 results"), put it in an aria-live="polite" region, and show a friendly empty state when nothing matches. Escape user input before inserting it into innerHTML (or build the mark with DOM nodes), and let Escape clear the field. The field gets a 1.5px accent ring on :focus-within. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Topic tabs
sub: Tabs swap the question list with a slide
html:
• Can I cancel anytime?Yes, from Billing in two clicks.
  • Where are my invoices?Billing, then Invoices. PDF on demand.
  • Do you prorate upgrades?We charge only the difference.
  • How do I reset my password?Use the link on the sign in page.

  • Is my data encrypted?At rest and in transit, always.
  • Can I export my data?CSV or JSON, any time you like.
  • Do you sell my data?Never. Not now, not later.
prompt: Build topic tabs for an FAQ (Billing / Account / Privacy). Use role="tablist" with three buttons and a 2.5px accent indicator under them that moves with transform: translateX() using a critically damped spring such as linear(0, 0.094 5.6%, 0.274 11.1%, 0.455 16.7%, 0.608 22.2%, 0.726 27.8%, 0.812 33.3%, 0.873 38.9%, 0.916 44.4%, 0.944 50%, 0.976 61.1%, 1 100%) over 590ms. Render the three question lists stacked in one relatively positioned box, each absolutely positioned; give each panel an offset custom property --o equal to its index minus the active index, and set transform: translateX(calc(var(--o) * 34px)) with opacity 0 on inactive panels and opacity 1 on the active one, so the old list slides and fades out one way while the new one slides in from the other, over 560ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Panels are role="tabpanel" with aria-labelledby, inactive ones get hidden or inert after the transition, and the arrow keys move between tabs. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

prompt: Build an FAQ with a spring chevron. Put the questions in one grouped white card with hairline dividers; each row ends with a 22px circular chip holding a small chevron-down SVG. On open, rotate the chip 180deg with a slight-overshoot spring such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%) over 700ms while the chip tints to your accent. The answer fades up: its paragraph goes from opacity 0 and translateY(10px) to opacity 1 and translateY(0) over 460ms, delayed 120ms so the panel is already opening. Animate the panel with the grid trick instead of height: put the answer in a wrapper with display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr, give its only child overflow: hidden and min-height: 0, and on open switch the wrapper to grid-template-rows: 1fr with transition: grid-template-rows 520ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Rotate with transform only; keep the chevron aria-hidden. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. title: Two-column FAQ
sub: Items cascade in across two columns
html:
Is it free to start?

Yes, the Starter plan is free forever.

Can I cancel anytime?

Cancel in two clicks, no fees.

Do you offer refunds?

Full refund within 30 days.

prompt: Build a two-column FAQ section where the items reveal in a cascade. Lay out the questions as a 2-column CSS grid of white rounded cards (question in semibold, answer in muted body text, always visible, no accordion). Reveal them with a stagger: each card starts at opacity 0 and transform: translateY(16px) scale(.97) and settles to its natural state over about 600ms with cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), delayed by index x 140ms so the cascade reads left to right, top to bottom. Trigger once with an IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.2) that adds an .in-view class to the grid, with the delay coming from a --i custom property on each card. Collapse to one column below 640px. Animate only opacity and transform, and under prefers-reduced-motion show every card immediately. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.

title: Chat-style FAQ
sub: Question bubble, then a typed reply
html: HelpTypically replies instantly
prompt: Build a chat-style FAQ widget. A rounded white window has a header (small gradient avatar, "Help", a muted status line), a message thread that is bottom-aligned with overflow hidden, and a row of suggested-question chips at the bottom. Clicking a chip appends the question as a right-aligned user bubble (accent gradient, white text, smaller bottom-right radius) that springs in with opacity 0 and translateY(10px) scale(.9) to its resting state over 460ms using a slight-overshoot curve such as linear(0, 0.083 5.6%, 0.26 11.1%, 0.457 16.7%, 0.633 22.2%, 0.774 27.8%, 0.876 33.3%, 0.944 38.9%, 0.986 44.4%, 1.008 50%, 1.02 61.1%, 1 100%). After 500ms show a left-aligned reply bubble containing three bouncing dots for about 900ms, then replace them with the answer typed in character by character (about 24ms per character). Keep the last three messages and drop older ones. Make the thread role="log" with aria-live="polite", write the full answer into the DOM immediately for assistive tech while typing it visually, and under prefers-reduced-motion skip the typing. Make each question a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer region (role="region" with aria-labelledby), support Enter and Space natively, keep a visible :focus-visible outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the transitions so panels switch instantly. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.
